children: Pebblebrook Hotel Trust announced it will report third‑quarter 2026 results on Oct. 29 and hold a conference call on Oct. 30.
Quarterly results for period ending Sept. 30, 2026 will be released after market close on Oct. 29, 2026.
Conference call scheduled for Oct. 30, 2026 at 9:00 AM ET; dial‑in provided and live webcast available on company website.
Call replay and webcast archive will be accessible via the Investor Relations section of pebblebrookhotels.com.
Company notes it owns 43 hotels (~10,900 rooms) across 14 urban and resort markets, underscoring portfolio scale.
